subject: Post-call: Procurement readiness & next steps (PO vs card / marketplace) — Northridge
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Post-call: Procurement readiness & next steps (PO vs card / marketplace) — Northridge

Hi Lindsey — thanks again for the 30-minute call earlier. Quick recap and the proposed next steps so we keep momentum moving toward a June/July pilot: 

Summary of what we heard
- Use case: customer support summarization for Tier‑1 agents, expected 1M tokens/mo in pilot.
- Primary constraints: finance prefers PO for vendor payments; security needs SOC2 evidence and SSO; legal wants a short SOW + standard T&Cs.
- Marketplace interest: your Platform Partnerships team asked about Redwood listing on the Northridge Partner Exchange — potential later stage.

Mutual Action Plan (attached: Northridge_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx) — proposed milestones:
1) Legal review of SOW & T&Cs — Northridge legal (target: 2 weeks)
2) Security due diligence — Redwood to share SOC2 summary + security questionnaire; Northridge InfoSec to review (target: 2 weeks, runs in parallel)
3) Finance signoff & PO issuance OR card payment test (target: 1 week after legal)
4) Provisioning & pilot kickoff (target: within 1 week of PO)

Clarifying questions / asks for your team:
- Who will own the PO issuance (name + email)? If finance prefers card initially, we can accept a corporate card for the pilot while PO is processed.
- Please confirm the Northridge legal reviewer’s email so we can route the SOW and standard terms.
- Do you want Redwood to start a marketplace intake form now, or wait until pilot success?

What we’ll do from Redwood:
- Share a concise SOW + our standard T&Cs (attached).
- Provide a SOC2 one‑pager and a completed security questionnaire (Jonas will send these today).
- Draft a short pilot runbook (configuration, KPIs, rollback) and share by EOD Friday.

Next call: propose 30 mins next Wed 6/17 to align on legal owner and PO timeline. Are you available 11:00–11:30 PT?

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this tight.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415‑555‑0132 | dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com

Dylan — great recap, thanks. 
A few quick notes from procurement/legal side:
- PO path: our procurement lead (Natalie Kim) will own the PO; I’ll loop her in. Ideally we get a pro‑forma SOW so finance can estimate monthly spend for budget approval.
- Card path: finance is open to a one‑month card-based pilot while legal reviews the SOW, but they will require receipts and a short justification for the card charge.
- Marketplace: hold off for now — Partnerships prefers we prove economics in pilot first.

I’m copying Natalie (natalie.kim@northridge-sys.com) and Jason from InfoSec (jason.hall@northridge-sys.com). Jason — can you confirm the InfoSec questionnaire timeline?

I’m available 6/17 at 11:00 PT. Send calendar invite.

– Lindsey
Head of CX Programs | Northridge Systems

Hi Lindsey / Dylan,
Attaching the SOC2 one‑pager and a completed high‑level security questionnaire for initial review. Quick notes on timelines and what we can provide immediately:

- Immediate (today): SOC2 summary (attached), answers to your standard A‑B questionnaire (see attached PDF stub).
- Near term (1–3 business days): sample encryption config, data retention policy excerpt, and an architecture diagram for pilot (we’ll send as PDF).
- If InfoSec requests deeper evidence (full SOC2 report, penetration test artifacts), we can route NDA + secure share link; that typically takes 3–5 business days to provision.

On the procurement path: we’ve seen customers do the card-first pilot (1 month) while the PO works through finance/legal — that reduces time-to-data and lets you validate cost per support ticket ahead of a longer term commitment. If you prefer PO-first, we can provide a concise SOW and a one‑page pricing estimate to speed approvals.

I’ll also add a short checklist to the MAP with the exact documents each team will need to approve (legal: SOW + T&Cs; security: SOC2 summary + questionnaire; finance: pricing estimate + billing contact).

Jonas Weber
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Action items assigned:
- Natalie (Procurement): confirm PO owner and preferred PO template (due: 6/19)
- Jason (InfoSec): initial review of SOC2 one‑pager + questionnaire and note any blockers (due: 6/19)
- Jonas (Redwood): add document checklist to MAP and attach SOW + pricing estimate (due: 6/16 EOD)
- Dylan (Redwood): provide brief pilot runbook + test card payment instructions (due: 6/16 EOD)

Proposed milestone dates (for MAP):
- 6/16: Redwood sends SOW, pricing estimate, runbook, security checklist items
- 6/19: Northridge legal & InfoSec provide initial signoff or list of redlines/concerns
- 6/23: Finance issues PO OR confirm card payment for one month pilot

If we get an initial green from finance for card payment, we can start the pilot as early as 6/24 while PO is processed. If PO is required first, expect pilot start 2–3 business days after PO issuance.

Attachments included in this thread: MAP, SOW template, SOC2 summary.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — we’ll keep updates in the MAP folder and HubSpot deal.
